reports.title: TransDigm Group Reports Fiscal 2026 Fourth Quarter and Year-End Results

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2027 Outlook
section: Mr. Lisman stated, "We are issuing full year fiscal 2027 guidance today, which reflects our current expectations for the year. We are well-positioned for continued growth as we head into our fiscal 2027 across all three of our primary end markets."
TransDigm is issuing fiscal 2027 financial guidance to be as follows:
•Net sales are anticipated to be in the range of $11,950 million to $12,150 million compared with $10,557 million in fiscal 2026, an increase of 14% at the midpoint;
•Net income is anticipated to be in the range of $2,442 million to $2,490 million compared with $2,108 million in fiscal 2026, an increase of 17% at the midpoint;

•Earnings per share is expected to be in the range of $42.06 to $42.91 per share based upon weighted average shares outstanding of 56.7 million shares, compared with $35.51 per share in fiscal 2026, which is an increase of 20% at the midpoint;

•EBITDA As Defined is anticipated to be in the range of $6,195 million to $6,345 million compared with $5,563 million in fiscal 2026, an increase of 13% at the midpoint (corresponding to an EBITDA As Defined margin guide of approximately 52.0% for fiscal 2027);
•Adjusted earnings per share is expected to be in the range of $47.09 to $47.94 per share compared with $41.35 per share in fiscal 2026, an increase of 15% at the midpoint compared to prior year; and
•Fiscal 2027 outlook is based on the following market growth assumptions:
◦Commercial OEM revenue growth in the high single-digit to low double-digit percentage range;
◦Commercial aftermarket revenue growth in the high single-digit percentage range; and
◦Defense revenue growth in the high single-digit percentage range.
